facts.fact: Statistics Denmark and Morocco's High Commission for Planning cooperate, in a 2024-2026 partnership funded by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, on the use of administrative data, and a 2025 peer review made recommendations on access to administrative data; no published statistics from administrative records are stated.

MAR.note: Only HCP's statistical business register software is named, not the government register of companies.
The document says nothing on police station records.
